summary.text: Pete Elverum is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 82 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, he served 14 years in the Army National Guard and Montana Army National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Elverum was born in Salem, Oregon, and served in the U.S. Army National Guard and Montana Army National Guard for 14 years.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Montana State University in 2006 and a law degree from Gonzaga Law School in 2009, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
Elverum took office on January 6, 2025, and was assigned to the House Local Government, Education and Taxation committees for 2025-2026.
